items.label: YouTube Series
items.title: Golf Is a Terrible Idea, Ep 1: Golf vs. Scotland (wide)
fields: A lot of countries claim they invented golf. Scotland is the only country that tried to kill it. In 1457 King James the Second makes golf illegal, and everybody goes golfing anyway. Three kings ban it, it never works, and in 1502 the same king who banned it buys himself a set of golf clubs. The royal receipt still exists.
In 1457 the King of Scotland made golf illegal. It did not go well for the King. Episode 1 of Golf Is a Terrible Idea, a funny history of golf brought to you by The Golffice.

items.label: YouTube Series
items.title: Golf Is a Terrible Idea, Ep 2: Golf vs. Geese (wide)
fields: For four hundred years, every golf ball on Earth was full of goose. Golf Is a Terrible Idea is brought to you by The Golffice. It's called the featherie. You take a leather pouch, you boil a top hat's worth of goose feathers, and you stuff them in with an iron rod and your chest. A good ball maker could finish about four a day. One ball cost more than a club. And the second it rained, your very expensive ball turned into a wet sock and split open on the fairway. The geese were not thrilled either. Every round of golf cost them a coat. Then, in 1848, a Scottish student named Robert Paterson gets a statue in the mail from India, packed in gutta percha, a rubbery tree sap. He looks at the packing, rolls it into a ball, and hits it. It's cheap, it's tough, and it does not care about rain. The greatest featherie maker alive, Allan Robertson, is furious. He buys every new ball he can find and burns them. Legend says he fired his own apprentice, Old Tom Morris, for playing one. A few years later, Allan Robertson is playing gutties too. The geese never forgave us. That's why they still hiss at you on the course. Nobody hisses at you in a Golffice bay. Open twenty four seven in Birmingham, Huntsville and Madison. Next time, golf goes to the Moon.
For four hundred years, every golf ball was stuffed with goose feathers. Then it rained. Episode 2 of Golf Is a Terrible Idea, a funny history of golf brought to you by The Golffice.
items.note: New episode. Each one tells one true story where someone tried to stop golf and lost.
